data.name: Genisia
data.gender_notes: Genisia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word genos, meaning race or kind, this name signifies a journey towards generosity and kindness. In the New Testament, a woman named Genesia is mentioned, demonstrating the spirit of selflessness and giving. The name Genisia carries the meaning “Journeying towards generosity” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Genisia usually hope their child will grow to embody journeying towards generosity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the journey towards generosity and selflessness
